before.name: Navigation item impressions and viewer CTR

source.query:
SELECT
    if(timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 7 DAY, 'current_complete_7d', 'prior_complete_7d') AS period,
    properties.navigation_schema_version AS schema_version,
    properties.navigation_surface AS surface,
    properties.navigation_group AS navigation_group,
    toInt(properties.navigation_item_position) AS item_position,
    properties.navigation_item_label AS item_label,
    properties.destination_url AS destination_url,
    uniqIf(properties.$session_id, event = 'navigation_item_viewed') AS viewing_sessions,
    uniqIf(properties.$session_id, event = 'navigation_click') AS clicking_sessions,
    countIf(event = 'navigation_click') AS clicks,
    round(100 * uniqIf(properties.$session_id, event = 'navigation_click') / greatest(uniqIf(properties.$session_id, event = 'navigation_item_viewed'), 1), 1) AS viewer_ctr
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 14 DAY
  AND timestamp < toStartOfDay(now())
  AND event IN ('navigation_item_viewed', 'navigation_click')
  AND properties.navigation_schema_version = 'nav-2026-08-04-a'
GROUP BY period, schema_version, surface, navigation_group, item_position, item_label, destination_url
ORDER BY period DESC, surface ASC, viewer_ctr DESC, viewing_sessions DESC
LIMIT 250

SELECT
    if(timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 7 DAY, 'current_complete_7d', 'prior_complete_7d') AS period,
    properties.navigation_surface AS surface,
    if(event = 'navigation_menu_opened', properties.menu_name, properties.navigation_group) AS menu_group,
    uniqIf(properties.$session_id, event = 'navigation_menu_opened') AS opening_sessions,
    uniqIf(properties.$session_id, event = 'navigation_click') AS selecting_sessions,
    countIf(event = 'navigation_menu_opened') AS opens,
    countIf(event = 'navigation_click') AS selections,
    round(100 * uniqIf(properties.$session_id, event = 'navigation_click') / greatest(uniqIf(properties.$session_id, event = 'navigation_menu_opened'), 1), 1) AS open_to_selection_rate
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 14 DAY
  AND timestamp < toStartOfDay(now())
  AND event IN ('navigation_menu_opened', 'navigation_click')
  AND properties.navigation_schema_version = 'nav-2026-08-04-a'
GROUP BY period, surface, menu_group
ORDER BY period DESC, surface ASC, opening_sessions DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    if(timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 7 DAY, 'current_complete_7d', 'prior_complete_7d') AS period,
    properties.homepage_layout_version AS layout_version,
    if(toInt(properties.viewport_width) < 768, 'mobile', 'desktop') AS viewport,
    toInt(properties.homepage_section_position) AS section_position,
    properties.homepage_section_title AS section_title,
    properties.content_title AS item_title,
    properties.destination_url AS destination_url,
    uniqIf(properties.homepage_visit_id, event = 'homepage_section_click') AS clicking_visits,
    uniqIf(properties.homepage_visit_id, event = 'homepage_destination_reached') AS reached_visits,
    round(100 * uniqIf(properties.homepage_visit_id, event = 'homepage_destination_reached') / greatest(uniqIf(properties.homepage_visit_id, event = 'homepage_section_click'), 1), 1) AS destination_reach_rate,
    round(avgIf(toFloat(properties.reach_time_ms), event = 'homepage_destination_reached'), 0) AS average_reach_time_ms
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 14 DAY
  AND timestamp < toStartOfDay(now())
  AND event IN ('homepage_section_click', 'homepage_destination_reached')
  AND properties.destination = 'internal'
  AND properties.homepage_layout_version = 'home-2026-08-04-a'
GROUP BY period, layout_version, viewport, section_position, section_title, item_title, destination_url
ORDER BY period DESC, clicking_visits DESC, destination_reach_rate DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT
    if(timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 7 DAY, 'current_complete_7d', 'prior_complete_7d') AS period,
    properties.navigation_schema_version AS schema_version,
    properties.navigation_surface AS surface,
    properties.navigation_group AS navigation_group,
    toInt(properties.navigation_item_position) AS item_position,
    properties.navigation_item_label AS item_label,
    properties.destination_url AS destination_url,
    uniqIf(properties.$session_id, event = 'navigation_click') AS clicking_sessions,
    uniqIf(properties.$session_id, event = 'navigation_destination_reached') AS reached_sessions,
    round(100 * uniqIf(properties.$session_id, event = 'navigation_destination_reached') / greatest(uniqIf(properties.$session_id, event = 'navigation_click'), 1), 1) AS destination_reach_rate,
    round(avgIf(toFloat(properties.reach_time_ms), event = 'navigation_destination_reached'), 0) AS average_reach_time_ms
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 14 DAY
  AND timestamp < toStartOfDay(now())
  AND event IN ('navigation_click', 'navigation_destination_reached')
  AND properties.destination = 'internal'
  AND properties.navigation_schema_version = 'nav-2026-08-04-a'
GROUP BY period, schema_version, surface, navigation_group, item_position, item_label, destination_url
ORDER BY period DESC, surface ASC, clicking_sessions DESC, destination_reach_rate DESC
LIMIT 200
